info.description: The Attachment Management Module provides API endpoints for uploading, storing, organizing, viewing, and retrieving digital files within the AOH platform.
info.title: Attachment Management Module (AMM) API

host: (configured at runtime - uses same host as Swagger UI)

post.description: Uploads one or more files with metadata. Files are scanned for viruses and stored in the configured storage provider.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all attachments associated with a specific module.
Retrieves a paginated list of all attachments associated with a specific entity within a module.
Retrieves the metadata of a specific attachment including file details, tags, and data access permissions.

put.description: Updates the metadata of an existing attachment including description, entity association, tags, and data access permissions.

get.description: Generates a secure, time-limited download ID that can be used to download the attachment without authentication.

delete.description: Marks an attachment as deleted without permanently removing it from storage. The attachment can be restored later.
Permanently deletes an attachment from the database and storage. This action cannot be undone.

post.description: Restores an attachment that was previously soft deleted, making it active again.

404.description: Attachment not found or not deleted

get.description: Downloads the attachment file using a previously generated download ID. The download ID must be valid and not expired.

400.description: Bad request - invalid or expired download ID
